messages:
Emma K: Heads-up — PR #8341 (kv-cache warmup fix) is blocking tonight's hotfix cutoff. Need 2x LGTM before 00:00 UTC. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8341
Raj P: On it, will re-review in ~20m. Any risky migrations or schema changes?
Emma K: No migrations. Just a guard + cache warmup tweak and updated unit tests. Taylor left one nit.
Taylor: Left a small comment about a potential null check in warmup path. Should be a 1-line fix. If patched I can re-approve.
Emma K: Pushed the fix (force-pushed small change) ~5m ago. @ci-bot can you kick the CI?
ci-bot: ci-bot: build queued for PR #8341 (sha: abcd123) — running tests.
Sarah: I can give the second LGTM once CI is green. Heads-up that I won't be online at midnight, would rather approve now if tests pass. :+1:
Dave: I have a free window for the next hour to clear approvals. Looking now.
Raj P: Quick flag — microbench on short sequences shows ~1.5% throughput drop. Not huge, but worth noting. @Taylor do you see any red flags?
Taylor: 1.5% is acceptable for this fix, especially since it prevents cache churn. No objections. I'll approve after CI passes.
ci-bot: ci-bot: all checks passed ✅ — integration, unit, and e2e tests successful.
Taylor: Taylor: LGTM
Raj P: Raj P: LGTM
Emma K: Emma K: Awesome, thanks everyone. Merging once the merge gate is open. @release-bot can we schedule the merge to hit before midnight cutover?
release-bot: release-bot: merge scheduled for 2025-11-08T23:50:00Z. Will abort/rollback if post-merge smoke tests fail.
Sarah: Sarah: Leaving a note in the release doc about the perf delta for observability.
Emma K: Emma K: Thanks all — closing the loop. :party_parrot:
